entities.name: José Luis Zorrilla de San Martín
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Zorrilla de San Martín  was a Uruguayan sculptor and painter. One of the pivotal sculptors from Uruguay, his most significant impact was through the monuments he created in the capital city of Montevideo. His style displayed elements of aesthetic baroque incorporated with modern sculpture.
